label: Run / MS levels
caveat: Distinct MS levels recorded; not a quality score.

label: Total spectra
caveat: Counts every MS level including empty scans.

label: Run time (s)
caveat: RT span from spectra, not LC separation chemistry.

label: MS1 spectra
caveat: Includes scans with no detected peaks.

label: Empty MS1 scans
caveat: Zero-TIC scans; interpret alongside the MS1 count.

label: MS1 peaks per scan (quartiles)
caveat: Valid stored peaks per scan, not identified molecular features.

label: Median MS1 TIC
caveat: Arbitrary instrument units; do not compare without calibration.

label: MS1 TIC variability (CV)
caveat: Undefined if the mean TIC is zero or too few scans are available.

label: MS1 scan rate
caveat: Scans per minute over the MS1 RT span.

label: MS2 spectra
caveat: Includes scans with no detected peaks.

label: Empty MS2 scans
caveat: Zero-TIC scans; interpret alongside the MS2 count.

label: MS2 peaks per scan (quartiles)
caveat: Valid stored peaks per scan, not identified molecular features.

label: Median MS2 TIC
caveat: Arbitrary instrument units; do not compare without calibration.

label: MS2 scan rate
caveat: Scans per minute over the MS2 RT span.

label: Median MS2 isolation width
caveat: Requires positive recorded isolation offsets; absent is not zero.

label: MS1/MS2 scan ratio
caveat: Undefined when there are no MS2 scans; not a performance score.

label: MS2 scans per acquisition cycle
caveat: MS1-delimited cycles only; not applicable to MS1-free targeted runs.

label: MS2 precursor charge fractions
caveat: Denominator is all MS2 scans; unknown charge is retained.
